deltabattle.ed.title: Battle editor
deltabattle.ed.menu_hint: Enter an id (without ':' = custom:name). Datapack battles can be overridden with the same id.
deltabattle.hint.pattern: Pattern: aimed (hover, then fly at the heart), rain, sweep, ring, spiral, hop, bounce.
deltabattle.hint.count: Number of bullets (ring: bullets per wave).
deltabattle.hint.speed: Bullet speed in pixels per tick (20 ticks per second).
deltabattle.hint.start: Ticks after the attack starts until the first bullet.
deltabattle.hint.delay: aimed: ticks a bullet hovers before it flies at the heart.
deltabattle.hint.damage: Damage to the player. 0 = the enemy's atk.
deltabattle.hint.weight: Weight for random attack choice (attack_mode = random).
deltabattle.hint.from: Where bullets come from: top / bottom / left / right / random.
deltabattle.hint.scale: Sprite size multiplier when drawing the bullet.
deltabattle.hint.texture: Texture, e.g. deltabattle:textures/gui/x.png. Empty = white circle / colored block.
deltabattle.hint.say: Enemy speech bubble during this attack. Empty = none.
deltabattle.hint.say_tick: Tick of the attack when the bubble appears.
deltabattle.hint.gap: ring: width of the gap (in bullets).
deltabattle.hint.hover: aimed: distance from the edge where the bullet hovers.
deltabattle.hint.music: Music: a sound id, e.g. deltabattle:music.battle1 or minecraft:music_disc.pigstep. 'stop' = silence. Empty = unchanged.
deltabattle.hint.when: Trigger: start, turn (n = turn number), hp_below (n = HP %), enemy_killed, enemy_spared, player_down.
deltabattle.hint.n: turn: turn number; hp_below: HP percent.
deltabattle.hint.text: Text in the bottom box. \n = new line. %1$s = player name, %2$s = enemy name.
deltabattle.hint.hp_pct: Stage starts when enemy HP <= this percent (0 = not by HP).
deltabattle.hint.turn: Stage starts from this turn (0 = not by turn). The last matching stage wins.
deltabattle.hint.notice: Menu text when the stage begins.
deltabattle.hint.phases: Boss stages: replace attacks / dialogue / flavor and may change music.
deltabattle.hint.cues: Text, dialogue and music at a chosen moment of the fight.
deltabattle.hint.attacks: This enemy's attack patterns (one is picked per turn).
deltabattle.hint.acts: ACT menu actions. mercy 100 = can be spared.
deltabattle.hint.party_sprites: Hero sprites (png) in order. Empty = built-in.
deltabattle.ed.no_model: No model. Pick a geo file on the right, or drop .geo.json / .animation.json / .png onto this window.
deltabattle.ed.click_soul: click the box to move the heart
deltabattle.field.name: Name
deltabattle.tip.none: Select an item on the left. Enemies, attacks, boss stages and text/music cues are in the tree. To add: select a list (yellow) and press +.
deltabattle.tip.Encounter: The whole battle: shared texts, music, rewards and colors. Enemies are under Enemies. 3D party members are under Party models.
deltabattle.tip.EnemyDef: An enemy. Use the 3D model branch to attach geo, animations and texture. Attacks, stages and acts are sub-branches.
deltabattle.tip.PhaseDef: A boss stage. Starts by HP% and/or turn number; replaces attacks and dialogue and can change music. The last matching stage wins.
deltabattle.tip.Cue: A cue: show text, a speech bubble, switch music or play a sound at a chosen moment (start, turn N, enemy HP below N%, enemy killed/spared, player down).
deltabattle.tip.ActDef: An ACT menu action. Mercy 100 = the enemy can be spared. The reply shows in the next attack.
deltabattle.tip.SpellDef: An ACT menu spell costing TP: party heal, damage or mercy.
deltabattle.tip.ItemDef: An inventory item that heals the player in battle.
deltabattle.tip_list: Press Add or + in the tree. Items appear in the tree on the left - select them to edit.
deltabattle.tip_model: Drag .geo.json, .animation.json and .png files into the game window - they appear in the drop-down lists (the v button).
deltabattle.hint.geo: Blockbench/GeckoLib model file (.geo.json). Pick from the list (v) or drop a file onto the window.
deltabattle.hint.anim_idle: Idle animation name (from animation.json). Pick from the list (v).
deltabattle.hint.yaw: Model rotation in degrees (adjust so it faces the right way).
deltabattle.hint.offset_x: Horizontal model offset on the battle screen.
deltabattle.hint.offset_y: Vertical model offset on the battle screen (down = positive).
